content: Static GitHub Pages SEO basics: unique title + meta description per page (50-60 / 120-160 chars); absolute canonical URLs are critical because username.github.io/repo and custom domain serve duplicate content and Pages offers no 301; OG + twitter:card with absolute 1200x630 JPEG image (not WebP); sitemap.xml + robots.txt referencing it; 404.html served automatically from root; favicon; one h1 per page; JSON-LD; submit to Search Console; verify OG against the live domain, not github.io.
